holder_request.summary: 주주는 이사회에 AI의 책임 있는 개발 및 배포에 대한 공식적인 감독을 요청하고 있다.

evidence.quote: Shareholders request the Board of Directors of Alphabet, Inc. to update the Audit Committee Charter to provide formal oversight on the responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence

company_response.summary: 회사는 이사회가 AI 관련 위험에 대한 감독을 이미 효과적으로 수행하고 있다고 주장하고 있다.

evidence.quote: The Board as a whole is ultimately responsible for risk oversight at Alphabet, including the strategic, execution, and human rights risks associated with AI.
The development and deployment of AI may create new unforeseen risks to the human rights of billions of users and stakeholders
Our Board believes that oversight of risks associated with the development and deployment of AI is already being carried out effectively at the full Board level.
unaddressed vulnerabilities in AI governance systems may eventually lead to costly and resource-intensive interventions
Our integrated internal governance and risk management protocols effectively manage AI risks.

proponent_note: 제안자는 The Shareholder Association for Research & Education로, 캐나다 연합 교회의 연금 계획을 대표하여 제안함.

vote_opinion.reason: 회사는 AI 관련 위험에 대한 감독이 이미 효과적으로 이루어지고 있다고 주장하며, 주주가 제기한 AI 감독의 필요성에 대한 우려에 대해 구체적인 답변을 제공하지 않았다.

evidence.quote: this rollback leaves an accountability gap around responsible AI governance addressing human rights risks.
our Board believes that this proposal is unnecessary and would not provide incremental benefit to our shareholders.
